title: Snake game
description: A classic Snake game built using JavaScript with smooth movement, score tracking, and increasing difficulty. Designed with a clean grid-based layout and responsive controls for an engaging gameplay experience.

title: Spotlight-effect
description: An interactive spotlight hover effect created using pure HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The project focuses on modern UI effects, smooth cursor tracking, and visual depth to enhance user experience.

title: Nike store
description: A responsive Nike-inspired e-commerce landing page showcasing limited edition products. Built with modern layouts, reusable components, and clean UI design to simulate a real-world brand store experience.

title: Winter store
description: A minimal winter clothing store website featuring product sections, modern typography, and a clean layout. Focused on responsive design and smooth navigation using Tailwind CSS.

title: Noclang Simulator
description: A visual simulator for the NocLang architecture that demonstrates core-to-core communication using ring topology and hop-by-hop routing. Built with React to help understand NoC concepts through interactive animations.
